product_metadata.title: Thirstystone Brand - Desert Sand Coaster, Multicolor All Natural Sandstone - Durable Stone with Varying Patterns, Every Coaster Is An Original 4 inch round
features: NATURAL SANDSTONE- Sandstone coasters are made from natural sandstone, which is a sedimentary rock composed of sand-sized minerals or rock grains. Sandstone is a sustainable and environmentally friendly material.
UNIQUE PATTERNS- Sandstone has a unique pattern of grains and colors, which makes each coaster a one-of-a-kind piece.

ABSORBENT- Sandstone is naturally absorbent. These Sandstone Coasters will continually absorb condensation from beverages. Sandstone is also heat tolerant, making it a great choice for protecting tables and countertops from hot beverages.

DURABLE- Sandstone is a durable material that can withstand wear and tear from daily use. Sandstone has a natural grip and non-slip surface that keeps glasses and mugs from sliding around when in use.
MEASURES- Each coaster measures 4” diameter. Sandstone coasters are easy to clean with a damp cloth or sponge.
description: Thirstystone Desert Sand Natural Sandstone Coaster 4 Pack
